title: ChatGPT and its model picker
summary: A quick question, a sustained research job and a change to a website can all start in ChatGPT. The place you start changes which models and tools you can use.

intro.what: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s assistant. Its model picker selects the model or thinking effort available for a conversation.
intro.features: Chat supports questions and drafting, Search and Deep Research consult sources, and data analysis works with files. ChatGPT Work produces deliverables, Codex works on software, and Images and Voice handle visual and spoken tasks.
intro.exchange: Compare two supplied mail-rule descriptions at higher effort. Match each claimed exception to the original text.
intro.m365: Start with a quick rewrite of a rollout notice. Check that dates, audience and effective time survived the rewrite.
intro.developer: Use chat to define a bug’s expected behavior, then give Codex that example and inspect the resulting test.
sources: OpenAI Help · ChatGPT Work and Codex
OpenAI Help · Deep research in ChatGPT

sections.title: Read the label in context
paragraphs: In regular ChatGPT, look at the mode beside the message box. On eligible paid plans the GPT-6 menu offers Instant, Medium, High and Extra High using GPT-6 Sol. These settings change the reasoning effort. A separate Pro choice uses GPT-6 Astra where available. Free and Go accounts have GPT-5.6 Luna Instant and Think. Workspace settings and rollouts can change the choices you see.

Work and Codex have their own model selections. The November 17 release introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for those surfaces and the API. Seeing GPT-6 in the ordinary chat picker and GPT-6.2 in Codex is consistent with the product documentation. An API model identifier in an announcement tells you little about your personal chat menu.
sources: OpenAI Help · ChatGPT Work and Codex

sections.title: Spend reasoning time where it pays off
paragraphs: Consider a trip itinerary. Instant is a reasonable first try for extracting the names of cities from your own notes. Try Medium or High for fitting the visits around booked trains, opening hours and a rest day. Ask for a table of constraints and the appointment each one affects. That gives you something concrete to check.

Try Extra High or Pro when an error would cause extensive rework or when a lighter mode repeatedly misses a constraint. A longer reasoning setting does not provide fresh train times. Use Search for the timetable and check the operator’s date before treating it as a constraint.
sources: OpenAI Help · Reasoning settings and availability

title: Choosing an OpenAI API model
summary: Developers can choose a model directly. A small test with your own work can tell you more about cost and suitability than a general ranking.

intro.what: The OpenAI API lets software call a particular model directly and process the returned result.
intro.features: Applications select model identifiers, send inputs and use the response in their own workflow. Capability, processing time and cost vary. Test real examples to see how many outputs meet your requirements.
intro.exchange: Classify redacted delivery reports by suspected cause. Compare results with engineer-labeled cases and count errors that would route a ticket incorrectly.
intro.m365: Convert supplied adoption notes into consistent categories. Score ambiguous records separately and keep the original row attached.
intro.developer: Compare two models for a puzzle hint generator. Record cost and latency per usable hint and reject hints that reveal the answer.

sections.title: Four useful starting points
paragraphs: These are API identifiers from the model catalog reviewed on November 22, 2026. The examples translate the capabilities OpenAI documents into trial tasks. They are editorial suggestions, not comparative benchmark results.

rows: Highest-capability option in the 6.2 pair for demanding reasoning and code
Review a change spanning several files and explain interactions across them.
General-purpose reasoning and coding with lower published token prices than Astra
Turn a project brief into a working first version, then run its checks.
Interpret an unfamiliar settings screen and locate the requested control.
Low-cost option for well-specified, repeatable work
Extract merchant, currency and total from a collection of short, clearly formatted entries.

sections.title: Compare cost per usable result
paragraphs: At the published standard text-token rates reviewed for this edition, one million input tokens plus 100,000 billable output tokens works out to $3 with Sol or $12 with Astra. The example assumes uncached input and excludes tools, storage and discounts. Tokens measure pieces of text. The billable output count can include reasoning tokens.

Give both models the same ten representative cases and a scoring key. Include a messy input and one case with missing information. Record correct answers, manual repairs, elapsed time and actual cost. If the cheaper model needs costly corrections for a particular class of input, reserve the larger model for that class. Chat subscriptions and API usage have separate billing arrangements.
sources: OpenAI Developers · Model selection and evaluation
OpenAI Help · Codex sign-in and billing choices

title: Search, research and data analysis
summary: These tools retrieve different kinds of evidence. Pick one by asking what a reader would need in order to check the answer.

intro.what: ChatGPT offers separate tools for looking up current information, researching across sources and calculating from a file.
intro.features: Search can retrieve a current reference, Deep Research can assemble a sourced report, and data analysis can run calculations on uploaded data. A public product page describes supported behavior. Your organization’s actual configuration needs its own evidence.
intro.exchange: Look up a mail-flow limitation in Microsoft documentation, then compare its conditions with a configuration export you are authorized to share.
intro.m365: Reconcile a usage report against a license export. Check unmatched accounts and the dates each file covers.
intro.developer: Compare two libraries for an offline app. Open the cited documentation and run a small offline test.
sources: OpenAI Help · Deep research in ChatGPT
OpenAI Help · Data analysis with ChatGPT

sections.title: One lookup or a research brief?
paragraphs: Use Search for a narrow question such as which station a railway operator lists for an airport transfer. Open the citation, find the route, and check the timetable dates. A link to the operator’s homepage alone would leave the question unresolved.

Use deep research when you need a synthesis across sources. For a three-city German holiday, give it your travel dates, hotel locations and latest acceptable arrival time. Let it read official transit and accessibility sites, look over its proposed plan, and request one row per transfer with journey time, operating days, a citation and any uncertainty. Deep research can use selected websites, uploaded files and supported connected apps when you grant access.
sources: OpenAI Help · Deep research in ChatGPT

sections.title: Inspect the arithmetic
paragraphs: Data analysis can use Python to inspect an uploaded spreadsheet, calculate totals and create charts. Give it column definitions, units, a rule for blanks and the original file. A screenshot of a wide table may hide rows or round the values you want to audit.

For parking occupancy, imagine two garages observed at the same moment. One has 90 of 100 spaces occupied, the other has 1 of 10. The system-wide rate is 91 out of 110, or 82.7%. Averaging the two garage percentages instead gives 50%, which answers a different question. Ask for the numerator, denominator and any excluded records beside each chart. Inspect the calculation before using the result.
sources: OpenAI Help · Data analysis with ChatGPT

title: ChatGPT Work and Codex
summary: Use Work to assemble a deliverable across materials. Use Codex when repository files, executable changes and tests are central to the job.

intro.what: ChatGPT Work handles multi-step assignments involving documents or tools. Codex is OpenAI’s agent for working on software.
intro.features: Work can assemble a deliverable from permitted sources. Codex can inspect an available repository, edit files and run its tests locally or in a configured cloud environment. Access follows that environment and its permissions.
intro.exchange: Give Codex a mail-report script and sanitized sample output. Run its revised parser on a fixture with a missing field.
intro.m365: Use Work to turn approved migration notes into a handover. Verify the owner and rollback condition against the source.
intro.developer: Give Codex a reproducible bug in your app. Inspect the patch and exercise the same screen after the fix.
sources: OpenAI Help · ChatGPT Work and Codex
OpenAI Help · Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan

sections.title: Choose the working environment
paragraphs: A conversation makes sense while you are deciding what a book should cover. In Work, supply the approved sources and ask for the finished manuscript. Connected tools, plan, workspace settings and permissions influence which materials it can read and which actions it can take.

For a code change, Codex can work with a local checkout or a configured cloud environment. Local work is a natural fit for files already on your computer. A cloud task is useful when you want to delegate work against a connected repository. A file saved only on your Mac needs to be supplied to the remote environment before it can use it.
sources: OpenAI Help · ChatGPT Work and Codex

sections.title: A bookshelf change you can verify
paragraphs: Suppose you want a Next button above every puzzle. Tell Codex which book already gets it right. Specify what should happen on the first and last pages, whether navigation should retain a partially solved puzzle, and which screens matter. Ask it to use the existing bookshelf controls and show the changed pages.

Review the changes, then open a middle puzzle, mark an answer, advance, return and verify that your mark survives. Repeat with a narrow screen and with the device offline after the book has been saved. The same assignment makes a practical comparison for Claude Code and Google Antigravity. Give each the same starting files and acceptance checks.
sources: OpenAI Help · Using Codex with your ChatGPT plan

title: Images, voice and the status of Sora
summary: A generated image, live voice exchange, transcript and video are four different outputs. Availability depends on the product you open.

intro.what: ChatGPT’s media features cover still images and spoken interaction. OpenAI’s discontinued Sora service also appears in older video tutorials.
intro.features: Images can generate and revise artwork. Voice supports spoken exchanges, and audio models can transcribe supplied recordings. For a finished visual, check the exported asset at its intended size.
intro.exchange: Rehearse a service-restoration briefing aloud. Compare the spoken impact, timeline and resolution with the incident record.
intro.m365: Practice explaining a sharing policy to a colleague. Check each claim in the rehearsal against the approved policy.
intro.developer: Generate two icon concepts, then inspect each at small size and against the actual app background.
sources: OpenAI Help · Sora discontinuation and dates

sections.title: Sketch an idea, then edit what matters
paragraphs: OpenAI introduced Images 2.6 on November 4, 2026. In ChatGPT you can create an image or edit one you supply. For a graduation nameplate, request a single dachshund in profile wearing a tilted cap, viewed straight on with broad shapes. On the next turn, ask it to preserve the dog’s outline while changing the angle of the cap. Checking what changed between edits is a useful measure of control.

The API offers Flare for fast drafts and Sunburst for higher-detail work. OpenAI also documents animated GIF creation in ChatGPT and SVG generation in the API. If the destination is a laser cutter, inspect the paths, units, outlines and physical dimensions in your design software before cutting.
sources: OpenAI Developers · Changes to image models and outputs

sections.title: Practice a conversation or capture a transcript
paragraphs: Use voice conversation to rehearse German at a hotel desk. Ask for one question at a time, answer aloud, then request a written correction after the exchange. For minutes from an existing audio recording, the desired output is a transcript. Preserve the original recording and check names and numbers against it.

The API catalog distinguishes live speech-to-speech models from transcription models. GPT-Live-1.1 is aimed at natural two-way speech. The November 19 update calls out pronunciation and multilingual voice. The catalog also lists realtime options for tool-using applications. An API model name alone does not identify which voice engine a particular ChatGPT account uses.

sections.title: Video after Sora
paragraphs: OpenAI’s discontinuation notice gives two dates. The Sora app and website ended on April 26, 2026. The Sora API ended on September 24, 2026. Tutorials that send you to either service predate those closures.

ChatGPT can still help prepare a shot list, a voiceover and still keyframes. For a 12-second bookshelf trailer, specify three four-second shots and a visual detail that must carry across all three. Take that brief to a currently available video generator covered in the media comparison, then inspect motion, continuity and audio in the rendered clip.
sources: OpenAI Help · Sora discontinuation and dates
